subject: english
title: Signal Words · Q3 W11 D04
objective: Identify words that show order, reason, contrast, or result in a text.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Signal words help readers understand how ideas connect: first shows order, because shows a reason, and so shows a result. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: A signal word that tells which event comes before the others.
A signal word that introduces a reason.
A signal word that shows a contrast.

items.prompt: Which words connect the first idea to the next one?

options.text: It rained, so the plants grew.

items.explanation: The answer is “It rained, so the plants grew.” It applies the lesson skill about order, reason, and contrast words.
